business_summary.text: Capital India Finance is an NBFC with lending and forex businesses; through subsidiaries it also runs a prepaid payment instrument business (Rapipay).

call_points.text: Credit cost rose to ₹35.91 Cr in FY26 from ₹4.04 Cr a year earlier.

penalties.details: SOP Fine of INR 10,000/- imposed under Regulation 60(2) of SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
penalties.impact: There is no impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company, other than the monetary fine paid.

entities.name: Capital India Asset Management Private Limited
NYE Investech Private Limited (formerly known as Kuants Wealth Private Limited)
Rapipay Payments Private Limited (formerly known as NYE Insurance Broking Private Limited)

industry: Financial Services > Finance > Non Banking Financial Company (NBFC)

operating_notes.text: Gross NPA was 2.50% and net NPA 1.32% at March 31, 2026, with CRAR at 40.99%.
Outstanding qualified borrowings rose to ₹924.24 Cr at March 31, 2026 from ₹665.17 Cr a year earlier.
The company issued 5,000 NCDs of ₹1,00,000 face value each, totalling ₹5,000 lakh (₹50 Cr), during FY26.
FY26 AUM ₹1,227 Cr across 46 branches in 9 states, with average LAP ticket size ₹70-75 lakh at 13-15% yield.
Cost of funds 9.38% in FY26 versus 10.22% in FY25, with incremental debt raised below 10%.
Total funds raised in FY26 were ₹618 Cr from 23 lenders, including 4 new lenders added during the year.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹125.15 Cr, net loss to shareholders ₹0.16 Cr (against a loss of ₹0.59 Cr a year earlier).
FY26 investor presentation (May 20, 2026): AUM ₹1,227 Cr (+22% YoY); PAT ₹40 Cr including a ₹97.92 Cr housing-subsidiary sale gain; CRAR 40.99%.

status_history.evidence: Gross NPA reported at 2.50% at March 31, 2026, with net NPA 1.32%.
